name: K'nonna
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

generalAbilities.name: Gilded Fascination
generalAbilities.description:
When offered a gift worth at least 50 gp, the k'nonna must attempt a DC 20 Will Saving Throw saving throw; if the gift is worth at least 100 gp, the DC is instead DC 25 Will Saving Throw.

If they fail the save, the k'nonna accepts the gift, becomes Fascinated until the end of their next turn, and cannot attack while fascinated. On a critical failure, the fascination lasts for 1 minute.

Offering a gift is an Interact action, and offering multiple gifts in the same round has no additional effect.

generalAbilities.name: Half Steps
generalAbilities.description: Even though k'nonna are split in half, they still move and Stride as though they have two arms and legs. However, binding just one wrist or ankle leaves them incapable of using that limb, as if it were bound to another.

defensiveAbilities.name: Half-Speaker
defensiveAbilities.description:
A k'nonna can communicate easily with other k'nonna, but when communicating with other creatures, only half of the spoken words make sense.

In order to convey information to a k'nonna or understand what they're saying, a non-k'nonna must succeed at a DC 20 Perception check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pounce
offensiveAbilities.description: The k'nonna Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the k'nonna began this action hidden, they remain hidden until after this ability's Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
